summary: The completed workflow passes T6, but the planner-owned close oracle does not prove three required close behaviors.
verified: vloop task gate T6 exited 0: gate T6: pass.
notes: gate_dispute: the T6 oracle only checks that --all contains the extra model line, never compares the whole output; it checks one value after refusal instead of byte-for-byte unchanged files; and it ignores doctor exit codes while checking warning substrings. Strengthen .vloop/state/gates/T6/oracle.go so the unchanged product is judged by the acceptance criteria rather than adding a product workaround.

gate_dispute.reason: The planner-owned close oracle omits assertions required by T6 acceptance: exact --all output, byte-for-byte all-or-nothing refusal, and warning-only doctor exit 0.
gate_dispute.evidence: The --all branch uses contains(r.stdout, "text-embedding-9  -\n", ...) instead of an exact equality; the disabled refusal checks only one model via config get rather than both configuration files byte-for-byte; and both doctor commands only inspect stdout substrings, not r.code. The unchanged gate nevertheless exits 0.
